tactics:
induction ‹List _› with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.nodup_cons, ih, List.count_cons]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ a
      by_cases hx : x = a
      · subst hx
        simp [List.count_eq_zero.mpr h1]
      · simp [hx, h2 a]
    · intro h
      refine ⟨fun hm => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
      · have := h x
        have := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hm
        simp at *
        omega
      · have := h a
        split at this <;> omega
simp only [List.nodup_iff_sublist, ← Nat.not_lt, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le, List.le_count_iff_replicate_sublist]; rfl
